raw_note: Beacon plan/generate friction: in beacon-loop native runner work, the user asked to directly replicate gnhf core long-loop capabilities, but planning/tests collapsed the source-parity scope into a minimum MVP skeleton. Research/truth said to absorb gnhf runner abilities, yet acceptance coverage was coarse and mock-oriented, so implementation delivered a one-iteration CLI/runtime-package skeleton instead of a complete orchestrator. Root issues: plan layer optimizes for smallest verifiable MVP, source capability inventory was not compiled into a parity matrix, requirement truth/tests did not preserve behavior-level granularity, evaluator accepted test-green skeleton evidence, and user intent for full business decomposition was under-specified by Beacon artifacts. Desired governance action: add a Source-Parity Delivery planning/evaluation mode that extracts source capability inventory, maps every source behavior to Beacon modules/tests, marks non-MVP mandatory items, requires user-approved deferrals, and blocks generate completion when implementation only satisfies a mock/bones acceptance table.
